verdict.rationale: Anytype lets users decide where their data lives. Content is stored locally on the device by default. A local-only mode turns off Anytype's backup node entirely. Users can also self-host the sync and backup network, using a team-maintained docker image, on infrastructure they control, which gives them direct residency control. Missing for 10: no region picker for Anytype's own hosted backup infrastructure; switching to self-hosting requires exporting and re-importing into a new identity; no independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted residency.
